events.name: New York Rangers at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Tom Wilson had two goals and an assist to lead the Washington Capitals past the New York Rangers 6-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tom Wilson has Gordie Howe hat trick in Capitals' 6-3 win against Rangers

events.name: Nashville Predators at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored his 600th career goal and the Nashville Predators beat the Vegas Golden Knights 4-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steven Stamkos scores goal No. 600, Predators win New Year's Eve matinee in Vegas 4-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Darren Raddysh scored midway through overtime, and the Tampa Bay Lightning blew three one-goal leads before beating the Anaheim Ducks 4-3 on Wednesday for their fifth consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Darren Raddysh scores in OT, Lightning beat Ducks 4-3 in coach Jon Cooper's 1,000th game

events.name: Minnesota Wild at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini had a goal and an assist hours after being selected to play for Team Canada at the 2026 Winter Olympics, and the San Jose...
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini celebrates Team Canada selection by leading Sharks past Wild 4-3 in shootout

events.name: Winnipeg Jets at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — John Gibson kept up his hot December with 24 saves, Dylan Larkin and Mason Appleton scored goals, and the Detroit Red Wings beat the slumping Winnipeg Jets 2-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: John Gibson makes 24 saves as surging Red Wings beat slumping Jets, 2-1

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Luke Hughes scored the go-ahead goal 4:45 into the third period and the New Jersey Devils scored three times in a 1:56 span in a 3-2 victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luke Hughes breaks 3rd-period tie in the Devils' 3-2 victory over the Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Tage Thompson scored twice within 2 1/2 minutes midway through the third period and had an assist as the Buffalo Sabres beat the Dallas Stars 4-1 on Wednesday night to extend their winning streak to 10 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thompson scores twice as Sabres beat Stars 4-1 for 10th straight victory

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored twice, including his 400th career goal, and Valeri Nichushkin netted his second NHL hat trick as the Colorado Avalanche beat the St. Louis Blues 6-1 on Wednesday night for their ninth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores 400th goal and Nichushkin nets hat trick as Avalanche rout Blues 6-1

headlines.description: — Dustin Wolf made 25 saves, Mikael Backlund scored his 10th goal and the Calgary Flames beat the Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flames beat Flyers 5-1 for 4th straight home victory

headlines.description: — David Pastrnak had two goals and an assist as the Boston Bruins closed out the calendar year with a much-needed 6-2 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pastrnak leads Bruins past Oilers 6-2 to stop 6-game slide
